$Y^{\mathrm{DDA}}_{a_z,a_y,q}[k,l]=\sum_{u=0}^{U-1}\lambda_uY^{\mathrm{DDA},q}_{a_z,a_y,u}[k,l]+Z^{\mathrm{DDA}}_{a_z,a_y,q}[k,l]$,
